title: AttributionAssertion
description: Cryptographically signed evidence that a publisher's data informed an agent's purchase decision. Minted at search time, consumed once at settlement. The signature covers every field except signature itself.

assertion_id.description: UUIDv7. Single use. Consumed at settlement and rejected on replay.

publisher_id.description: The publisher credited with the referral.

product_id.description: Canonical product the assertion covers. Binding to canonical rather than listing lets the agent transact with any merchant carrying the product.

search_request_id.description: The search that produced this recommendation. Creates the auditable chain from query through payment to ledger entry.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 UTC. One hour after issue by default. Attribution should reflect a recent decision.

commission_bps.description: Basis points. Signed, so neither merchant nor publisher can alter the agreed rate after issuance.

signature.description: Ed25519 over the canonical JSON of all other fields, base64. Prefixed 'ed25519:' to make the scheme explicit and prevent algorithm substitution.
